slides.title: Problem
points: Hackathon teams spend the last hours writing docs instead of finishing the build.
A repo with no README is hard to judge, demo, or hand over.

slides.title: Solution
points: campus-queue: paste a repo URL, get a README, a demo script, and an 8-slide deck.
Every line is traced to a file in the repo — nothing invented.

slides.title: Live demo
points: Paste the repo URL and watch the file tree and summary appear.
README, script, and deck render in under a minute.

slides.title: How it works
points: 1. Read the repo: manifests, entry points, routes, tests.
2. Summarise what the files actually show.
3. Write the README, script, and deck from that summary.

slides.title: Tech stack
points: Languages in the repo: Markdown, JSON, JavaScript, HTML, CSS.

slides.title: What is next
points: Add a live deployment link once the app is hosted.
Add screenshots of the app running.
Fill in the team slide with real names before presenting.
